text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, so sluggish~... No waay~... My joints ache all over~... Can't move my bodyyy...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Come on, Pandora! I made porridge, so get up out of bed.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...What flavor porridge? Did you put in... salmon flakes...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Of course. And there's jelly, too! A reward for taking your medicine earlier♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ! ...I'm happy about the jelly, but~. I really don't wanna take that medicine anymoreee...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Look, you need to get better fast, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It's this weekend! Didn't you say you were going to Sapporo?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: U-Uuuughhhhh. Veggies are so biiittteeerrrr.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, Pandora...! You normally complain over a single leaf of salad, so what on earth happened to you!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm trying hard to eat it so I can get over my cold! I always hear vitamins are super important, so~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It is certainly good for your health, but~... Please do not push yourself too hard, Pandora-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah. Taking it totally easy might actually cure you faster, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...No way! Since I don't usually eat them, they might work twice as well on my body! So I'm gonna eat them... Nggghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: G-Gnnnh... I wanna touch my phone~... Wanna watch UmaTube, wanna watch UmaTok!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: But I gotta sleep a lot, so... Endure, endure!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Pandora-san... You're right. When resting, one should rest properly.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What amazing willpower, Pandora-chan! Yes, yes! I'm cheering you on!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yeah, leave it to me! This much self-control is nothing for genius Pandora-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Heart-chan. Are you still awake~?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Did you have a scary dream or something?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! Nothing like that... You know how I worked suuuper hard today, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: But, you know... Was there something more I could've done~...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Come over here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: There, there. You did your best. You'll definitely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Heart-chan. ...Hehehe♪ Feels like my cold just flew away!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's sleep, let's sleep! Sleeping is the absolute most important thing after all~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, you really are something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In front of the academy one day—I saw a group of five holding suitcases, happily chatting away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Even so, Pandora-sama. I am so glad you recovered safely~.
choice_data_list: Were you feeling under the weather?
Are you all going on a trip together?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Well~, ya think? But I knocked it out in record time♪

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The day after we visited, she was already full of energy! Hehe, she really is like a manga protagonist!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hehehe♡ For a trip, this much is a breeze♪ Don't underestimate Pandora-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Right, right! Eating yummy food~ shopping! We're gonna hit up all the tourist spots like the Clock Tower too~!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, she's been like this since yesterday. Constantly sharing all the places she wants to visit on LANE.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm so excited I can hardly sit still!! Let's make tons and tons of memories together, everyone♪
